scope: Production implementation inventory and ADR-aligned ownership map. New protocol fields are planned contracts, not existing API declarations.

source.note: Line references describe the inspected current working tree, including the prior repair batch; source revision alone does not capture that batch.

status_definitions.existing: A production implementation with the described limited semantics exists.
status_definitions.additive: A real implementation can be extended, but the planned guarantee is not present.
status_definitions.missing: No equivalent was found in the inspected production entry points; this is not a runtime capability claim.

items.name: Native ABI and ownership
items.existing: Legacy platform layout is frozen; db_platform_v2 uses struct_size/version and appended fields. Returned strings use db_free.
items.gap: Any new operation ABI must be additive; no structure reorder or changed ownership.

items.name: Capability negotiation
items.existing: effectiveFeaturesDoc and capabilitiesJsonOnLoop publish measured and Core feature flags.
items.gap: ADR defines new object-valued feature entries operations_v1, admin_sessions_v2, web_request_lanes_v1, media_publish_v1, config_cas_v1, config_conflicts_v1, config_import_v1 and panel_identity_v1. They are absent now. Existing capability booleans and their readers retain their types; new adapters must understand the versioned objects.

items.name: Layered operation results
items.existing: HTTP uses ok/err and route-specific HTTP statuses. Open-door C ABI uses integer status; emergency_v2 uses 1/0. Configuration batch already returns a JSON result.
items.gap: No action-level operation_id/request_id/execution_state/retry_mode contract was found in the inspected action paths. Existing call identity and Telegram test request IDs do not provide equivalent physical-action semantics.

items.name: Cookie write protection
items.existing: Admin and panel login issue HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookies.
items.gap: The inspected server has no explicit CSRF token or trusted Origin validation. SameSite is not a complete implementation of the proposed cross-surface write contract.

items.name: HTTP queued-request lifecycle
items.existing: runOnLoop captures a request copy and shared completion state; handler exceptions become HTTP 500; the wait is bounded at 5000 ms.
items.gap: Pending has done only. A timed-out queued handler can still run; there is no atomic QUEUED/RUNNING/EXPIRED distinction or not_started proof.

items.name: Physical operation prepare/execute/query
items.existing: openDoorOnLoop appends a durable dtmf_action event. doEmergency appends durable emergency state events. Store has local event transactions and dispatch frontiers.
items.gap: There is no prepared operation ledger, immutable parameter binding, operation query, durable once-only dispatch claim or correlated actuator ACK. Event origin/seq and call_id cannot replace an operation handle.

items.name: Execution authority
items.existing: Current MQTT effects are emitted by the node locally elected mqtt_bridge leader. Mesh CMD has authenticated peer attribution.
items.gap: Local partition leaders are not a unique action authority. ADR defines explicit door-open and independent global SOS authority bindings. The implementation must fail closed for missing/unreachable/ambiguous authority without selecting another executor or inventing a door for global SOS.

items.name: Administrator session revision and expiry
items.existing: AdminCredential reads the replicated admin.password_hash record; local password changes clear sessions. LwwEntry provides hlc, author and seq metadata.
items.gap: sessions is a set of token strings; no credential revision, issue/interaction time or absolute expiry is stored. Capacity removes the lexicographically first token. Remote credential changes do not have the requested session-version contract.

items.name: Panel credential binding
items.existing: PanelCredentialBinding stores token_generation plus canonical secret refs and panelTokenOk compares the current binding on each cookie check.
items.gap: The current shared credential does not identify an independently revocable panel or constrain each panel to door grants. Bearer compatibility also exists and must be accounted for.

items.name: Independent panel identity
items.existing: SIP credentials are resolved from sip.accounts.<node_id> and platform secure storage.
items.gap: No independent authenticated panel_id/grants/revocation/SIP-provisioning protocol was found in panel session creation.

items.name: Call ownership and lease
items.existing: Web lifecycle validates door/call_id/stage_revision/dialog_owner; webDialogOwner derives a node-scoped value from a validated dialog_id; the current lease is 10000 ms.
items.gap: Success returns dialog_owner but no remaining lease. Client-supplied dialog_id is not an independently authenticated panel identity. Heartbeat still runs from the coupled load chain and transient failure ends the call.

items.name: Browser request generations
items.existing: runtime.js and video-session.js contain real shared browser logic, with existing single-settlement and stale-session tests in T01.
items.gap: The planned independent state/locale/config/heartbeat request chains and uniform deadlines are not established by those existing helpers alone.

items.name: Call-bound media authorization
items.existing: POST /call-frame checks a panel credential, local door-station role, SIP InCall and JPEG signature; peer-frame.jpg exposes a cached frame for 3000 ms.
items.gap: No principal/call/revision/owner/media-generation/frame-sequence authorization or final-write recheck exists here. The upload route currently returns wildcard CORS.

items.name: Encrypted transport and bounded media dispatch
items.existing: SecureChannel provides PSK authentication, XChaCha20-Poly1305 protection and replay checks. Mesh sends authenticated CMD messages; existing media proxy infrastructure is present.
items.gap: SecureChannel and transport callbacks run on Runloop. sendCommand is void and drops unavailable-peer requests. There is no demonstrated bounded asynchronous media-forwarding lane, frame authorization forwarding protocol or result correlation.

items.name: Resource limits
items.existing: HTTP body reading has an 8 MiB cap.
items.gap: See current_transport_and_resource_boundaries. Current SNAP is 300 KiB, BLOB/assets 3 MiB, and HTTP/TCP have 8 MiB thresholds with different allocation/enforcement points. None directly implements the ADR 1 MiB frame or 4 MiB staged import contracts.

items.name: Local compare-and-commit
items.existing: configBatchJsonOnLoop is shared by HTTP and native ABI, validates up to 256 operations, commits atomically and returns revision with hlc compatibility alias.
items.gap: No expected_revision comparison occurs. The returned last mutation HLC is not a cluster-wide transaction/CAS version.

items.name: Partition edit intent retention
items.existing: LwwEntry carries hlc/author/seq; winner selection orders hlc and author and commits through a rollback-capable callback.
items.gap: The map retains effective winners; losing field intentions and parent revisions are not a persistent recoverable conflict ledger.

items.name: Bounded import staging
items.existing: POST /api/config/import validates supplied entries and calls one LwwMap mutate.
items.gap: No staging token, preflight snapshot, subject/file binding, TTL or expected baseline commit contract exists at this route. Existing import is separate from the ordinary 256-op batch limiter.

items.name: Evidence provenance
items.existing: T01 records production baseline/candidate execution, mutation sensitivity, browser behavior, cleanup and corrected environment discovery with source provenance.
items.gap: Evidence scopes remain host/browser/cross-build as recorded; none establishes real actuator success, signed device runtime, legacy hardware budgets or release qualification.

items.name: Core call time snapshot
items.existing: Current dirty-tree active_calls records include expires_at_ms, server_now_ms and remaining_ms in corrected Core time; schema documents their cached-snapshot semantics. No stage_deadline_ms source field was found.
items.gap: Presence does not close T19-T24 platform qualification; never compare the Core deadline with the OS clock or cancel solely from a UI timer.

mesh.identity: Authenticated SecureChannel peerId, not browser-supplied from.
mesh.deduplication: Transport replay rejection is not durable operation deduplication.
mesh.authority: Targeted existing connection; unavailable target logs and returns; no physical operation query/reply contract.

ha.identity: MQTT unlock payload carries door only. Scoped reply JSON can carry call_id/stage_revision.
ha.deduplication: No operation_id in unlock publication and no correlated ACK persistence.

sip_dtmf.identity: Configured feature code in the local SIP path; no stable operation handle.

entrypoints.frozen_archive: ios-legacy remains excluded from feature changes.

field_ownership_recommendations.note: New persistent operation identity; not call_id or event origin:seq.
New physical-operation lifecycle with explicit uncertain outcomes.

ADR operation authority field. Door-open binds doors.<id>.operations.authority_node; global SOS binds cluster.operations.sos_authority_node and does not select or invent a door. Neither implicitly chooses a partition-local MQTT leader.
Proposed correlation field; never an authorization credential.
Proposed common error vocabulary with legacy err compatibility.
Proposed action retry guidance; server authorization remains mandatory.
Internal queued/running/completed/expired arbitration, separate from persistent operation state.
ADR server-only credential binding to the persisted LWW tuple {hlc, author, seq}; seq uses a decimal string in new JSON. No independent local counter.
Interaction idle and absolute limits, monotonic within a process; restart invalidates in-memory tokens.
Proposed server-authoritative remaining Web dialog lease, separate from the ringing-call remaining_ms.
Existing corrected Core timestamp in active_calls; consumers must keep its time domain.
Existing corrected Core call duration snapshot; no UI-only cancellation authority.

ADR server-derived principal/door/call/revision/owner/publisher/generation binding, in memory for at most 10000 ms, capped by owner lease/Web session. Final frame-bus write revalidates; late frames never renew.

ADR 128 secure random bits encoded as 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters. In-memory authorization expires within 10000 ms, never outlives owner lease/Web session, and renewal issues a new generation.
ADR decimal string 1..9223372036854775807, strictly increasing in one media_generation; no leading zero, sign, exponent, wrap or reuse.
Frame bytes/pixels, bounded workers/queues and deadlines; qualification still requires measured budgets.
ADR required local CAS baseline on new endpoints. Uses the same complete-configuration token as config_generation; boot/restore invalidates it, with no cross-node equality or ordering guarantee.
ADR retained edit-intention identifier, 128 secure random bits encoded as 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters; parents use LWW record identities rather than boot-local revision tokens.
Proposed subject/file/TTL-bound staging and atomic local commit.
ADR random authenticated panel identity, at most 64 ASCII characters; never inferred from IP/UA.
ADR explicit panel door/action grants and separate global SOS start/clear permission. A door grant does not confer global SOS-clear permission; legacy shared credentials remain visibly shared.
Proposed measured configured/ready/provisioning_required outcome; no fabricated PBX provisioning.
New versioned JSON result envelope uses 2 and preserves legacy ok/err where present.
ADR bounded enum: response_lost, crash_during_dispatch, transport_ambiguous, ack_unavailable.

ADR authority-local complete-configuration token shared with expected_revision, opaque at most 256 bytes, invalidated by boot/restore epoch. It is frozen at operation preparation; execute cannot replace it.
ADR prepare duration, nonnegative integer at most 30000 ms; restart invalidates unexecuted prepared records.
Actual current Core active_calls deadline field; do not rename to stage_deadline_ms or invent a second deadline API.

field_ownership_recommendations.field_or_semantic_group: Correlated actuator ACK and sensor evidence
field_ownership_recommendations.note: ADR actuator acknowledgement is distinct from dispatch and observed door state; the observation may carry operation_id only when causally correlated.
T09 owns the request primitive; request lane orchestration is separately owned by T10.
T10 owns independent state/call-info/locale/config scheduling; it consumes T09 cancellation and settlement rather than defining another request contract.
ADR media authorization duration, exact JSON integer 0..10000, capped by owner lease and Web session. Estimate from monotonic request start; renewal reauthorizes and creates a new media_generation.

ADR random 128-bit in-memory session token; 30-minute interaction idle and 8-hour absolute limits, capacity 128. Background polls never refresh; restart/revocation/credential changes invalidate; renewal requires authenticated identity bootstrap.

ADR explicit authority for cluster-global SOS, independent of configured doors. SOS prepare omits door and rejects a supplied door. Legacy SOS remains available under its weaker contract until operations_v1 is commissioned.

design_gaps.gap: Existing elected MQTT duty does not supply an unambiguous fixed door action authority during partitions.
design_gaps.required_decision: ADR binds door-open to doors.<id>.operations.authority_node and cluster-global SOS to cluster.operations.sos_authority_node, without requiring or selecting a door. T06 must implement validation, quiesced changes, authenticated routing and unavailable/ambiguous refusal before operations_v1; legacy SOS availability is preserved until commissioning.

design_gaps.gap: Authenticated encrypted transport exists, but the present Runloop transport lacks the required bounded asynchronous media lane.
design_gaps.required_decision: ADR keeps cross-node media DESIGN_BLOCKED until T16 validates delegated identity, a separate bounded execution context, worker ownership, shutdown and queue limits. Existing SNAP/BLOB is not the replacement upload lane.

design_gaps.gap: Plan example limits are not demonstrated legacy-device memory/latency budgets by this inventory.
design_gaps.required_decision: ADR admission ceilings are explicit protocol bounds rather than measured historical-device capacity; owning tasks and T40-T48 must prove actual bounded allocation/storage and publish lower target limits when needed.

design_gaps.gap: SameSite cookies are the visible current protection; explicit trusted Origin/session-bound CSRF behavior is absent from the inspected HTTP paths.
design_gaps.required_decision: ADR requires a session-bound token plus exact configured Origin checks for new Web mutation routes. T06 must implement this without treating absent Origin as native authorization or trusting arbitrary forwarded headers.

design_gaps.gap: Current LWW data retains winners rather than losing edit intentions.
design_gaps.required_decision: Define a bounded persistent authenticated intent/conflict record that commits with configuration; local CAS alone cannot close partition conflict handling.

design_gaps.gap: SNAP admits 300 KiB JPEGs; BLOB/asset paths admit 3 MiB; proposed media frame and import caps are 1 MiB and 4 MiB. HTTP/TCP 8 MiB thresholds do not establish upfront per-route bounds or bounded queues.
design_gaps.required_decision: T16 and T29 must implement their own reviewed admission/ownership semantics while reusing eligible authenticated transport/storage primitives. Do not label old SNAP/BLOB as supporting the new sizes or new authorization/atomicity guarantees.

current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.name: snapshot_payload
current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.enforcement: Local provider and responding peer clear oversized JPEGs before response. The receiver base64-decodes the JPEG without a corresponding explicit byte/pixel limit in handleSnapResp.
current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.reuse_limit: An ADR 1 MiB upload exceeds this 300 KiB snapshot provider ceiling. SNAP does not bind call publisher, sequence or media authorization and runs on the Core loop; it is not the T16 upload lane.

current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.name: blob_payload
current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.enforcement: Provider rejects data above 3 MiB, emits 256 KiB base64 chunks, and receiver rejects accumulated decoded bytes above 3 MiB after decoding a chunk.
current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.reuse_limit: This is asset/blob fetching, not a 4 MiB configuration upload/staging transaction. Full-data/chunk allocation and Core-loop processing do not satisfy media worker/queue or import atomicity requirements.

current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.name: asset_upload
current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.enforcement: Asset-specific validation has a 3 MiB ceiling.
current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.reuse_limit: An asset ledger is not the transient media frame bus or configuration import staging store.

current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.name: http_request_body
current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.enforcement: Reader appends each read then stops once accumulated body reaches the threshold; no generic 413 result is produced here. The final read can cross the threshold and the body can be truncated.
current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.reuse_limit: The threshold is neither an exact upfront 1 MiB media rejection nor a complete 4 MiB staged-import limit.

current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.name: tcp_encrypted_frame
current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.enforcement: Declared frame length above 8 MiB closes the connection after socket reads have already appended data to inbuf_.
current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.reuse_limit: This per-frame limit is not a queue/global allocation bound; serialized/base64/crypto overhead must be budgeted separately.

current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.name: secure_channel_pending
current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.enforcement: sendMessage appends to pending_ before open with no explicit item/byte admission limit in this path.
current_transport_and_resource_boundarie.reuse_limit: Cryptographic authentication is reusable; the unbounded pending path and Core-loop ownership are not an already qualified media transport.

adr_alignment_findings.observed_adr: C06 refers to already introduced stage_deadline_ms.
adr_alignment_findings.resolution: ADR now references the existing expires_at_ms together with server_now_ms/remaining_ms; no second deadline API is introduced.
adr_alignment_findings.note: Historical finding resolved in the aligned ADR; implementation and qualification remain separate.

adr_alignment_findings.finding: ADR fixes 128 random bits, but unlike operation_id does not explicitly freeze string encoding/length for these new wire IDs.
adr_alignment_findings.resolution: ADR fixes both media_generation and change_id to 128 secure random bits encoded as 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
adr_alignment_findings.note: Historical finding resolved in the aligned ADR; implementation and qualification remain separate.

adr_alignment_findings.finding: Both are opaque local revision strings bounded at 256 bytes; exact relationship and scope must be unambiguous for prepare binding versus CAS comparison.
adr_alignment_findings.resolution: ADR specifies the same at-most-256-byte opaque token for config_generation and expected_revision on one authority complete-configuration snapshot; boot/restore epoch invalidates old tokens. Replicated conflict parents retain LWW identities.
adr_alignment_findings.note: Historical finding resolved in the aligned ADR; implementation and qualification remain separate.

adr_alignment_findings.finding: ADR calls panel Web sessions short-lived but only fixes administrator idle/absolute limits. Panel session duration, capacity/eviction and refresh behavior need one owner-defined contract before T15/T31 depend on it.
adr_alignment_findings.resolution: ADR fixes identity-bound panel sessions to 30-minute interactive idle/8-hour absolute lifetime and capacity 128, memory-only; no background refresh; restart/revocation/observed credential version changes invalidate; renewal requires fresh identity bootstrap.
adr_alignment_findings.note: Historical finding resolved in the aligned ADR; implementation and qualification remain separate.
